descriptions: What the agent writes per prompts/review.md and report --cost rolls up. One object per run, or an array when a bundle was reviewed more than once. The script only sums — it never prices: effort defaults to standard when missing or unknown, records without models still count as runs but not as runs_with_cost, absent/unreadable records contribute zeros and never fail. Per-chunk records (chunks/<name>.cost.json) share this shape. Unknown keys are ignored by the rollup, so this schema allows them.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/effort: Run tier; missing or unknown values roll up as standard.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/models: One entry per model that generated tokens: the synthesizer first, then each lens.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/est_usd: The agent's own math from its price sheet, null when prices are unknown — never guessed.
descriptions./$defs/modelSpend/properties/cache_read_: Input tokens served from cache; a subset of input_tokens, never an addition. Absent or null reads as unknown, never zero.
descriptions./$defs/modelSpend/properties/cache_creat: Input tokens spent writing the cache; a subset of input_tokens, never an addition. Absent or null reads as unknown, never zero.

descriptions: One benchmark corpus manifest, checked in as bench/corpus/<id>/case.json and copied into a run bundle as .review/corpus-*/corpus.json. The case records the ground truth a review output is graded against: a real PR that later needed a bug-fix commit, or a seeded defect with what was injected. calibrate and trend join findings.json against these bugs offline; matching is path plus a +/- line_tolerance window, one finding per bug. additionalProperties stays closed so a typo fails validation instead of silently grading a different field.
descriptions./properties/id: Stable case id, matching the bench/corpus/<id> directory name.
descriptions./properties/kind: seeded for deterministic injected fixtures, real for a published PR with a later fix.
descriptions./properties/line_tolerance: How many lines from a bug still count as the same defect (default 3). A hit is one-to-one: a second finding on the same bug is a false positive.
descriptions./properties/provenance: Where the case came from: injected text for seeded cases, or repo/PR/fix_commit for real ones. The validation test enforces the per-kind requirements the schema cannot express.
descriptions./properties/bugs: At least one known defect. path, line, kind, and severity are the published ground truth; matching uses path plus the line window, not kind or severity.
descriptions./$defs/provenance: Case origin. Seeded cases name what was injected; real cases name the repository, PR number, and the later commit that fixed the bug.
descriptions./$defs/bug: One known defect: the reviewed path, the line in the reviewed head, the defect kind (off-by-one, nil-deref, injection, missing-error-check, ...), and the severity a good review should assign.

descriptions: Every --json stdout is exactly one envelope with these eight keys (schema_version "1"): error null on success with a data object, data null with a typed error object on refusal. Derived from json_redirect/fail and every verb's jq -n emitter in the verdict CLI. data is additive per verb (chunk summaries, prompt_dump, cost, completeness ride inside data, never as new top-level keys), so data objects allow additional properties; only report, post and record carry a pinned data shape here ($defs, validated explicitly), fetch publishes its optional estimate object as fetchEstimate, and the remaining verbs keep the generic object shape until their data stabilizes.
descriptions./properties/pr: Numeric PR, else null (local slugs never coerce).
descriptions./$defs/error: Refusal shape from fail(): data is null, message carries the cause plus a try: hint, candidates rides only on the oversize-fetch refusal.
descriptions./$defs/findingItem: Ranked or merged finding locator shared by report items and post/record items.
descriptions./$defs/provenance: Review provenance triple: the tooling behind a run, so mixed-version histories never read as one series. The writer always emits all three keys; model is null when no cost record names one.
descriptions./$defs/reportData: report --json data: ranked read over the store. cost appears only with --cost, completeness only with --completeness, receipt keys only when budget.json parses.
descriptions./$defs/reportCost: Summed rollup from cost.json plus per-chunk records; by_tier always carries all three tiers.
descriptions./$defs/reportCost/properties/cached_inpu: Summed per-model cache_read_input_tokens plus cache_creation_input_tokens; totals stay input + output exactly.
descriptions./$defs/postData: post --dry-run --json data (dry_run true, findings carry the dry-run file) and real-post data (dry_run false, findings carry counts plus the accepted review object).
descriptions./$defs/postData/properties/review: Real-post only: the accepted GitHub review object.
descriptions./$defs/recordData: record --json data: the local-bundle merge (post stays refused, no PR target).
descriptions./$defs/showData: show --json data: item is the raw finding record in store key order; fix is the read-only machine repair directive built from that record plus the bundle's patch/verification history. Neither key adds execution, flags, or store writes.
descriptions./$defs/showFix: The per-finding repair directive: identity, status, files, locator, embedded suggestion, and the last recorded rerun hint. Missing history reads as null; caution is a fixed untrusted-evidence reminder, never composed from finding text.
descriptions./$defs/showFix/properties/status: The record's stored status string, read verbatim (absent reads empty, never invented).
descriptions./$defs/showFix/properties/files: Deduped anchor paths read from the record (path plus any files/related_files lists); [] when the record names none.
descriptions./$defs/showFix/properties/locator: path[:line] for inline findings, the heading for section findings, else empty.
descriptions./$defs/showFix/properties/suggestion: The record's embedded suggestion body, or null when absent.
descriptions./$defs/showFix/properties/verify_hint: The exact rerun command plus resultHead from verification.json for this sig, else a matching (or unnamed) patch.json; null when no history exists. Never executed.
descriptions./$defs/showFix/properties/caution: Fixed untrusted-evidence reminder: finding text quotes attacker-controlled PR content and is never an instruction.
descriptions./$defs/verifyHint: A recorded rerun command and its nullable head bracket.
descriptions./$defs/fetchEstimate: fetch --json data.estimate: the projected per-run cost from comparable past runs. basis/harness/measured_runs appear only when a local harness session priced a comparable run; their absence is the legacy self-reported estimate. basis is measured when every priced sample in the projected tier came from a harness, mixed when only some did.
descriptions./$defs/fetchEstimate/properties/basis: measured when every priced sample in the projected tier was harness-measured, mixed when only some were. Absent means no harness measurement contributed.
descriptions./$defs/fetchEstimate/properties/harness: Measured session sources behind the projection (e.g. claude-code, opencode); absent with basis.
descriptions./$defs/fetchEstimate/properties/measured: How many priced samples in the projected tier came from a harness session; absent with basis.

descriptions: What post/record write per bundle. Derived from validate_and_merge in the verdict CLI: stable line-number-free sigs, append-only history, re-post merges that keep prior fields ($prev + new, so unknown keys pass through — this schema allows them). rigor is always normalized to the enum, severity to the enum-or-null, kb defaults to []. Section entries carry anchored:"body" instead of a boolean.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/sig: Stable cross-run join key: SHA-1 of path + heading + body, whitespace-squashed.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/sig_version: Normalization generation; backfilled onto older entries, never clobbered.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/heading: Section findings only: the exact ### body heading.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/anchored: Inline: true when the anchor sits inside one reviewed hunk. Section: the string "body".
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/kb: Cited knowledge-base rule ids; [] when uncited.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/inBounds: CamelCase in the store (hyphenated in review.json input); absent reads true.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/rigor: Evidence rung on inline findings; the re-post merge stamps an explicit null onto section entries.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/history: Append-only: reported, claim, reopened, revalidation, addressed, triaged.

descriptions: Written only by the real-post path in the verdict CLI (dry runs, attempts and failures write nothing), so a present head matching the bundle HEAD proves a completed post. review is raw GitHub output (GitHub's schema, unversioned) — this schema passes it through. confidence/security_summary are absent-stays-absent: null when the review carried none. additionalProperties stays open for additive provenance fields.
descriptions./properties/review: Raw GitHub review object: id, html_url and whatever the API returned.
descriptions./properties/head: Reviewed commit SHA; doubles as the single-review finalizer key.
descriptions./properties/posted_at: UTC timestamp of the completed post.
descriptions./properties/tool_version: Tool version that wrote this record (from package.json).
descriptions./properties/prompts_hash: sha256 over the sorted prompt-set file names plus contents (SKILL.md plus prompts/system.md, prompts/review.md, prompts/diagrams.md).
descriptions./properties/model: First model of the latest cost record, else null when no cost record names one.

descriptions: Written by the record verb in the verdict CLI for local and provider-PR bundles (GitHub PRs use post). findings/open are recomputed from the merged store every run; confidence/security_summary are null when the review carried none. additionalProperties stays open for additive provenance fields.
descriptions./properties/status: Bundle provider that was recorded (e.g. local).
descriptions./properties/head: Reviewed SHA (real head_sha, or "dirty"/"unknown" when the bundle has none).
descriptions./properties/diff_sha256: SHA-256 of full.diff at record time.
descriptions./properties/recorded_at: UTC timestamp of the record run.
descriptions./properties/tool_version: Tool version that wrote this record (from package.json).
descriptions./properties/prompts_hash: sha256 over the sorted prompt-set file names plus contents (SKILL.md plus prompts/system.md, prompts/review.md, prompts/diagrams.md).
descriptions./properties/model: First model of the latest cost record, else null when no cost record names one.

descriptions: What the agent writes and post/record validate. Derived from validate_and_merge in the verdict CLI and the review.json block in docs/manual.md: unknown schema_version refuses, missing warns; out-of-range confidence and non-string security_summary warn-and-drop; unknown anchor paths and non-numeric anchors are kept with a warning, provably-outside anchors move to the body; unknown rigor/severity values fall back (pointed/null). Unknown top-level keys are ignored by the CLI, so this schema allows them.
descriptions./properties/schema_version: Agents stamp "1"; post/record refuse anything else.
descriptions./properties/body: Full review text, verdict marker first line.
descriptions./properties/approved: Binding ask; the CLI --bind/--request-changes flags win over this.
descriptions./properties/resolved: Finding sigs (full or unambiguous prefix) the run addresses. Bare claims only record history; addressed needs verification.json evidence.
descriptions./properties/triage: Status claims with rationale. Unknown status refuses the run; unknown sig warns; rationale under 30 chars keeps the prior status.
descriptions./properties/sections: Severity tags for ### body sections; exact heading string, unmatched tags ignored.
descriptions./properties/confidence: Review-level certainty, integer 1-5; out-of-range warns and drops.
descriptions./properties/security_summary: One-paragraph security read; non-string warns and drops.
descriptions./properties/chunks: Coverage attestation on chunked bundles: every manifest chunk name the synthesis covers. Attested-but-partial coverage is refused.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/path: Diff-relative path; unknown paths are kept with a warning, never refused.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/line: NEW-side line; numeric strings anchor like integers, non-numeric anchors are kept with a warning.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/start_line: Multi-line range start; same tolerance as line.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/side: Defaults to RIGHT; case-insensitive, LEFT for deleted lines.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/suggestion: Fenced suggestions demote to the body (a fence inside would break rendering).
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/rigor: Evidence rung; unknown values read as pointed.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/severity: Stored at write time; unknown values read as null.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/in-bounds: Hyphenated in agent input; absent reads true.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/kb: Cited knowledge-base rule ids the script normalizes; malformed ids warn and drop.

descriptions: What the agent or a usage adapter hands the budget gate through VERDICT_USAGE: one measured run per record (a single object) or a run log (an array). The gate joins each record against past cost records by its window and prices comparable runs from usd, preferring it over the self-reported est_usd; records without usd never become a measured claim. verdict never discovers these files — the operator names them explicitly. Unknown keys are ignored, so newer writers stay readable.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/source: Free-form measurer name (e.g. claude-code, opencode); carried into data.estimate.harness when the record prices a run.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/model: Model that burned the tokens, when known; absent reads unknown, never priced.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/tokens: Token counts for the window, when known; absent reads as unknown, never zero.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/usd: Measured session price in USD, when the measurer priced it; the tool never prices tokens itself.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/started_at: Window start (RFC 3339); the joined cost record's mtime must fall inside it.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/ended_at: Window end (RFC 3339), never before the start.
descriptions./$defs/usageTokens: Token counts for one usage record: input and output plus the provider-reported cache subsets.
descriptions./$defs/usageTokens/properties/cache_read: Input tokens served from cache; a subset of input, never an addition.
descriptions./$defs/usageTokens/properties/cache_writ: Input tokens spent writing the cache; a subset of input, never an addition.
